title: Doc: fsdir ops struct free_key_priv comment missing wolfP11-be5 ref
description: In wp11_backend_usb_flash.c, the NULL free_key_priv slot is annotated with the wolfP11-be5 tag and mentions ks_slot_clear_keys. In wp11_backend_fsdir.c, the equivalent comment is shorter and omits the wolfP11-be5 tag and the ks_slot_clear_keys reference. The ks_slot_clear_keys function in wp11_pkcs11.c uses free_key_priv == NULL as a sentinel to identify keystore-backend keys; this invariant is load-bearing. Fix: align the fsdir comment with the flash comment, adding the wolfP11-be5 tag and the ks_slot_clear_keys reference.
